subject: Notice: Privacy & supplier (supply chain) processor additions — timelines and review checklist
messages:
From: Elena Sokolov <elena.sokolov@starlight.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@starlight.ai, legal@starlight.ai
Date: 2027-11-04 08:12 -0800
Subject: Notice: addition of downstream processors — request for timeline and controls mapping

Hi Marcus,

Quick heads up from our side: Starlight is updating our vendor list and we received notice that Redwood intends to engage two additional downstream processors that will affect logging and telemetry used for model performance telemetry. Per section 4(b) of our current DPA, we need a formal notice with:

- a CSV of the processors being added (name, country, processing purpose)
- the proposed notification window (we expect 45 days unless otherwise agreed)
- the control mappings (ISO27001 / SOC2 / encryption at rest / key management)

Can you send the CSV and confirm whether Redwood expects to push changes to the DPA (redlines) for the transfer/retention clauses? If you plan to send a redline, please include a proposed e-sign timeline — our procurement prefers DocuSign.

We have a compliance review scheduled the morning of Nov 21, so if we could have materials by Nov 11 that would help.

Thanks,
Elena Sokolov
Head of Legal, Starlight AI
elena.sokolov@starlight.ai

---
Attachments: none (requesting attachments from vendor)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Sokolov <elena.sokolov@starlight.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-04 10:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Notice: addition of downstream processors — request for timeline and controls mapping

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and timing. We can provide everything you requested. Outlined plan below: 

1) Processor CSV (names + countries + purposes) — attached (processor_list_20271104.csv).
2) Proposed DPA redline for retention/transfer clarifications — attached (proposed_dpa_redline.pdf).
3) Controls mapping summary (SOC2/ISO/KMS): short PDF included inside the redline package.
4) E-sign: we prefer DocuSign; happy to follow your process if you provide the link.

We note the standard contract allows 45 days for objections. For strategic customers we can discuss shortening that to 30 days if it helps your timeline; want to keep clarity on what triggers an objection (material access to customer data vs telemetry-only processors).

Would you be available for a 30-minute call this week to walk through the redline and the control mappings? I’ve looped Karthik and Neha on legal and privacy details.

Thanks — sending attachments now.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134

---
Attachments: processor_list_20271104.csv, proposed_dpa_redline.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Sokolov <elena.sokolov@starlight.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-04 13:20 -0800
Subject: Re: Notice: addition of downstream processors — request for timeline and controls mapping

Elena — quick follow up from legal counsel.

Thanks for flagging the review window. A few clarifications from our side:
- The redline limits the objection window to 45 days per the existing DPA language; we can accept a 30-day operational notice in writing for telemetry-only processors if Starlight prefers — but would need an explicit carve-out in the DPA.
- For cross-border transfers: if any processor is outside the EU/UK we will ensure either SCCs or an approved transfer mechanism is in place prior to any production data flow; we’ll list the intended mechanism per-processor in the CSV.
- Retention: our proposed redline narrows retention for telemetry to 90 days by default (configurable per customer), with an option for customers to request longer retention in writing.

If you’re comfortable, we can prepare the DocuSign envelope and send our countersigned DPA; otherwise we can receive your DocuSign. Link would be helpful.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: proposed_dpa_redline.pdf

From: Elena Sokolov <elena.sokolov@starlight.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@starlight.ai
Date: 2027-11-04 15:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Notice: addition of downstream processors — request for timeline and controls mapping

Thanks Marcus and Karthik — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few items from our side after a brief review:

- Retention: 90 days default for telemetry is acceptable, but procurement will ask for the clause that allows customers to opt-in for extended retention to be explicit and auditable. Please add the change log language that shows when a customer requested extended retention.
- Controls mapping: procurement wants each processor row to include the primary certification (SOC2 Type II / ISO27001) and whether the processor stores keys in customer-managed KMS.
- Objection window: our legal prefers to keep the 45-day clause. Operationally procurement will escalate if you want to shorten it — they will need written confirmation (email thread is fine) that Redwood accepts 30 days for telemetry-only processors.

Procurement also requested our preferred signing flow: we attach PO# 5772 and ask that Redwood send a DocuSign envelope to procurement@starlight.ai with the final countersigned DPA.

Can you post the updated CSV with certification columns and the redline updated for the change log language? If you can get that to us by EOD Nov 8 we should be able to hit our Nov 21 compliance window.

Best,
Elena

---
Attachments: PO_5772.pdf (from procurement)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Sokolov <elena.sokolov@starlight.ai>, procurement@starlight.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-04 17:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Notice: addition of downstream processors — request for timeline and controls mapping

Hi Elena — thanks, we’ll update the CSV and redline and send by Monday morning Nov 8 EOD (PST). A few quick confirmations so we’re aligned:

- We’ll add certification and KMS columns to the CSV and include the per-processor intended transfer mechanism.
- We will add explicit change-log language to the retention section so customer opt-ins are recorded and auditable.
- Regarding objection windows: our baseline DPA language is 45 days; we accept 30 days for telemetry-only processors for Starlight if procurement confirms that preference in writing (reply-to-all here).

DocuSign: Per your PO, I created an envelope with the proposed countersigned DPA. Link: https://app.docusign.com/some-doc-id-12345 (sent to procurement@starlight.ai). Please let me know if you’d prefer Redwood to receive the initial signature instead.

Processor CSV is attached here for your immediate review (processor_list_20271104.csv). We’ll follow up with the redline update in the morning.

Next steps:
- Elena/procurement confirms whether they want 30 days for telemetry-only processors in writing (reply-all).
- We deliver updated redline + controls mapping by Nov 8 EOD PST.
- DocuSign completion targeted by Nov 12.

Thanks everyone — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Marcus Lin
